resolved_by_db08.reason: Migration 0071_model_less_legacy_sales is shipped and already applied, so it is the schema source of truth for sales_order_items. The ORM described the pre-0071 shape; 187933b9 aligns model_id nullability, finished_goods_stock_id with its named FK and index, source_model_code, source_model_name, and the ck_sales_order_items_product_reference CHECK that Alembic autogenerate does not compare.
resolved_by_db08.verification: Post-fix rerun of the real migration chain on PostgreSQL reports exactly these six differences gone and adds none. Baseline edited deliberately, not regenerated.
resolved_by_db08.still_unresolved: At this historical sales-alignment checkpoint, 21 entries remained. They are now preserved verbatim in resolved_by_ismail_completion; 94 accepted normalized differences remain globally.

resolved_by_db08_beyka.reason: Migration 0076 created cutting_beika_material_usages but no ORM class or relationship was ever added, so the table read as 'remove_table' drift with both its indexes. Adding CuttingBeikaMaterialUsage and the CuttingRecord.beika_materials relationship removed exactly those three entries and introduced none. Verified by a fresh migration bootstrap on PostgreSQL 17.11: 3 disappeared, 0 appeared.
resolved_by_db08_beyka.verification: Alembic autogenerate against a database built by running the full migration chain, compared entry by entry against this baseline. Only the three entries listed here disappeared; nothing was added, changed or reclassified.
resolved_by_db08_beyka.still_unresolved: Not a claim of ORM parity. The remaining 21 entries are untouched.

resolved_by_ismail_completion.reason: ORM aligns with 21 shipped DB08 contracts plus both duplicate unique constraint/index pairs. Forward 0138 creates nine declared HR indexes and verifies/removes two redundant unique indexes plus five equivalent FKs. Historical revisions unchanged.
